credentials.name: classic
credentials.description: A thank-you to one AID (schema 1.0.0), not yet sealed: valid by the issuer's current key.

credentials.name: condition-group
credentials.description: A thank-you to a condition (schema 2.0.0): any of two AIDs.

credentials.name: condition-claim
credentials.description: A letter to an e-mail address: the condition is one claim key.

credentials.name: condition-unknown-kind
credentials.description: A condition with a leaf of a kind this version does not know; the credential is still valid.

credentials.name: condition-malformed
credentials.description: A condition that does not parse: the credential verifies, but nobody can ever hold it (see presentations).

credentials.name: attachment
credentials.description: A thank-you naming an attached file by its BLAKE3 digest.

credentials.name: tampered-message
credentials.description: The message was changed after signing.

credentials.name: tampered-recipient
credentials.description: The recipient AID was swapped for another.

credentials.name: tampered-version
credentials.description: The size in the version string is wrong.

credentials.name: non-canonical
credentials.description: Same content, but not in the canonical serialization (whitespace).

credentials.name: non-canonical-order
credentials.description: Same content, fields in another order.

credentials.name: non-canonical-escapes
credentials.description: Same content, non-ASCII text escaped as \uXXXX.

credentials.name: schema-mismatch
credentials.description: Recipient in a.i under the condition schema 2.0.0.

credentials.name: schema-unknown
credentials.description: A type SAID this reader does not know: the envelope is checked, the type is reported unknown.

credentials.name: unknown-attribute
credentials.description: An attribute not in the schema (a.mood), with SAIDs recomputed.

credentials.name: no-signature
credentials.description: The signature group is missing.

credentials.name: forged-signature
credentials.description: Signed by another identifier's key, claiming to be the issuer.

credentials.name: kel-bad-signature
credentials.description: The issuer's inception event carries a broken signature.

credentials.name: kel-of-someone-else
credentials.description: The bundle carries another identifier's KEL.

credentials.name: kel-forged-inception
credentials.description: Mallory writes an inception event for Alice's AID with Mallory's own keys (its SAID does not recompute) and signs a thank-you 'from Alice'.

credentials.name: title-too-long
credentials.description: A title of 201 characters (the schema allows 200), SAIDs recomputed.

credentials.name: version-plus-sign
credentials.description: The version string writes the size as '+0019c' (same number, not canonical); SAID recomputed.

credentials.name: stale-kel-offline
credentials.description: Signed by the issuer's key at issuance; the bundle carries only that KEL. Offline this verifies (the verifier does not know about the later rotation).

credentials.name: rotated-unsealed
credentials.description: Same thank-you, checked against the issuer's fresh KEL: it was never sealed and the key rotated, so it is void.

credentials.name: rotated-sealed
credentials.description: Sealed in a period before the rotation: valid with the fresh KEL and its period seal.

credentials.name: rotated-sealed-second-leaf
credentials.description: The other thank-you of the same period.

credentials.name: rotated-no-seal
credentials.description: Sealed, but the holder did not supply the seal: it counts as unsealed.

credentials.name: seal-of-another
credentials.description: The period seal of a different thank-you.

credentials.name: seal-not-anchored
credentials.description: A close record that the issuer never anchored.

credentials.name: anchored
credentials.description: An older thank-you anchored on its own (an event seal naming its SAID); still valid after rotation.

credentials.name: redeemed
credentials.description: Valid, and redeemed by the issuer (a digest seal of the redemption record).

credentials.name: abandoned-issuer
credentials.description: The issuer abandoned its identifier (rotation to no next key); unsealed thanks are void.

credentials.name: private-full
credentials.description: dzq/1.1: title and message in the salted block, shown. Signature covers the compact form.

credentials.name: private-compact
credentials.description: The same statement with the block replaced by its SAID: same id, same signature.

credentials.name: private-edited-message
credentials.description: The full form with the message changed after signing.

credentials.name: private-wrong-digest
credentials.description: A compact form whose content SAID was swapped for another.

credentials.name: private-no-salt
credentials.description: A content block without a salt (SAIDs recomputed): guessable, refused.

credentials.name: private-bad-salt
credentials.description: A salt that is not 128 bits (SAIDs recomputed).

credentials.name: private-title-outside
credentials.description: A private-schema statement with the title outside the block (SAIDs recomputed).

credentials.name: private-condition
credentials.description: dzq/1.1 to a condition (schema 2.1.0), full form.

credentials.name: gratitude-1.2
credentials.description: dzq:gratitude 1.2.0, the built-in type document: to one AID, private block.

credentials.name: gratitude-1.2-condition
credentials.description: The same type to a condition: one type document covers both (a.i or a.dq).

credentials.name: gratitude-1.2-compact
credentials.description: Compact form of gratitude-1.2: same SAID, same signature.

credentials.name: gratitude-1.2-missing-field
credentials.description: A required private field is missing (SAIDs recomputed): the known type refuses it.

credentials.name: gratitude-1.2-too-long
credentials.description: A public field longer than the type's max (SAIDs recomputed).

credentials.name: apology
credentials.description: dzq:apology: nothing public but the envelope.

credentials.name: apology-compact
credentials.description: The same apology, compact: only who, to whom and when are visible.

credentials.name: apology-extra-field
credentials.description: An apology with a public category its type does not have (SAIDs recomputed).

credentials.name: promise-to-one
credentials.description: dzq:promise to one AID.

credentials.name: custom-type-unknown
credentials.description: A statement of a type this reader does not know: envelope, SAIDs and signature are checked; the result says the type is unknown.

credentials.name: custom-type-known
credentials.description: The same statement, with the type document given to the reader.

credentials.name: custom-type-compact
credentials.description: The same statement, compact: the text is hidden, the area stays public.

credentials.name: custom-type-breaks-type-unknown
credentials.description: Missing a required field of its type, read without the type: still a valid envelope (fields are not checked).

credentials.name: custom-type-breaks-type-known
credentials.description: The same, read with the type document: refused.

credentials.name: envelope-float
credentials.description: A float in a field (SAIDs recomputed): not allowed in any type.

credentials.name: envelope-reserved-name
credentials.description: A public field named u (reserved).

credentials.name: envelope-c-not-last
credentials.description: a.c before a public field.

credentials.name: envelope-no-dt
credentials.description: No a.dt.

credentials.name: envelope-too-large
credentials.description: A statement over 256 KB.

credentials.name: re
credentials.description: A gratitude that answers another statement (re = its SAID).

credentials.name: re-compact
credentials.description: Compact: the link is hidden with the text.

credentials.name: re-not-a-said
credentials.description: re is not a SAID (SAIDs recomputed).

credentials.name: look-full
credentials.description: A gratitude naming a look (dzenq:<SAID>), full form.

credentials.name: look-compact
credentials.description: The same, compact: the look is hidden with the text.

credentials.name: look-changed
credentials.description: The look was swapped for another after signing.

credentials.name: look-without-source
credentials.description: A look with no source (SAIDs recomputed): refused.

credentials.name: promise
credentials.description: A dzq:promise 1.1.0 to a condition, with ask and payload. Without the extension it is just a valid statement.

credentials.name: promise-compact
credentials.description: The same promise, compact: what, ask and payload are hidden; until stays public.

credentials.name: promise-1.0
credentials.description: A dzq:promise 1.0.0 (what, note) stays valid and known.

archives.name: minimal
archives.description: Only credential.acdc.

archives.name: with-metadata
archives.description: credential.acdc and metadata.json (display only).

archives.name: legacy-signatures-json
archives.description: Written by DzenQ before dzq/1.0: an empty signatures.json, ignored.

archives.name: lying-metadata
archives.description: metadata.json disagrees with the credential; metadata is never trusted.

archives.name: attachment
archives.description: With the attached file the credential names.

archives.name: attachment-swapped
archives.description: The attached file was replaced; the credential is valid, the file is not its.

archives.name: attachment-missing
archives.description: The credential names a file the archive lacks.

archives.name: tampered
archives.description: A .dzq around a tampered credential.

archives.name: path-traversal
archives.description: An entry that escapes the archive.

archives.name: unexpected-entry
archives.description: An entry dzq/1.0 does not define.

archives.name: no-credential
archives.description: No credential.acdc.

archives.name: too-many-entries
archives.description: More than 20 entries.

archives.name: not-zip
archives.description: Not a ZIP file at all.

archives.name: private-attachment
archives.description: dzq/1.1 full form with its attachment: the file is checked against the private block.

archives.name: private-compact
archives.description: dzq/1.1 compact copy for showing: no text, no attachment, still valid.

archives.name: custom-type-carried
archives.description: A .dzq that carries its type document as types/<SAID>.json: any reader can check the fields.

archives.name: custom-type-carried-tampered
archives.description: The carried type document was edited: it is ignored, the statement is valid, type unknown.

archives.name: reserved-source-carried
archives.description: A carried type document claims the reserved dzq: source: ignored, type unknown.

archives.name: look-carried
archives.description: A gratitude with its look/1 document and picture inside the .dzq (extension: looks).

archives.name: look-named-only
archives.description: A catalogue look, named but not carried.

archives.name: look-document-tampered
archives.description: The carried look document was edited: the statement is valid, the look is not used.

expect.look: invalid: the look's SAID does not match its content

archives.name: look-forbidden-file
archives.description: A carried look uses a GIF: not an allowed file type.

expect.look: invalid: images must be PNG, JPEG or WebP

presentations.name: classic
presentations.description: Bob proves he holds a thank-you addressed to him.

presentations.name: wrong-nonce
presentations.description: The same proof, made for another request.

presentations.name: display-only
presentations.description: No verifier code was asked for: shown, but proves no freshness.

presentations.name: not-the-recipient
presentations.description: Carol presents Bob's thank-you as hers.

presentations.name: group-member
presentations.description: Carol holds the group thank-you (any of Bob, Carol).

presentations.name: letter-claimed
presentations.description: Dave got the letter key through his e-mail and claims the letter.

presentations.name: letter-no-claim
presentations.description: Dave presents the letter without the claim.

presentations.name: letter-claim-for-another
presentations.description: Dave presents a claim made out to another AID.

presentations.name: letter-claim-bad-signature
presentations.description: The claim signature does not verify.

presentations.name: all-of-two-claims
presentations.description: all(…) of two claim keys, both claimed.

presentations.name: all-of-two-claims-one-missing
presentations.description: all(…) with only one of the two claims.

presentations.name: unknown-kind-other-leaf
presentations.description: Bob meets any(txn:…, Bob) through his AID; the unknown leaf is never met.

presentations.name: malformed-condition
presentations.description: Nobody holds a thank-you whose condition does not parse.

presentations.name: tampered-payload
presentations.description: The payload was edited after the holder signed it.

presentations.name: sealed-after-rotation
presentations.description: Bob presents a sealed thank-you whose issuer rotated since; the bundle carries the fresh KEL and the presentation the seal.

presentations.name: unsealed-after-rotation
presentations.description: The same issuer's unsealed thank-you, with the fresh KEL: void.

presentations.name: forged-holder-kel
presentations.description: Mallory presents Bob's thank-you with a forged inception for Bob's AID carrying Mallory's key.

presentations.name: condition-in-a-i
presentations.description: A schema 1.0.0 thank-you whose a.i holds a condition (pre-1.0 test letters); under dzq/1.0 a.i is one AID, so Mallory does not hold it.

presentations.name: missing-dt
presentations.description: A presentation payload without dt.

presentations.name: private-compact-at-door
presentations.description: Bob shows a dzq/1.1 thank-you to a door without its text.

presentations.name: private-letter-claimed-compact
presentations.description: Dave claims a dzq/1.1 letter and shows it without its text.

presentations.name: promise-earned
presentations.description: Marko shows the promise with three thank-yous from Dad (all compact).

presentations.name: promise-too-few
presentations.description: Only two of the three thank-yous.

presentations.name: promise-same-thanks-twice
presentations.description: The same thank-you three times counts once.

presentations.name: promise-wrong-category
presentations.description: Three thank-yous, but two are in another category.

presentations.name: promise-wrong-issuer
presentations.description: Two of the thank-yous come from a neighbour, not from Dad.

presentations.name: promise-not-a-holder
presentations.description: Erin is not in any(Marko, Sofia), even with three thank-yous.

presentations.name: promise-expired
presentations.description: Earned, but shown after 'until'.

presentations.name: promise-two-issuers-add-up
presentations.description: thanks:3 from Dad+Neighbour: one from Dad and two from the neighbour.

presentations.name: promise-mixed-terms
presentations.description: thanks:3/<Dad>:cleaned the room+<Mom>:*: two from Dad for the room and one from Mom for anything.

presentations.name: promise-mixed-terms-wrong-category
presentations.description: Two from Dad for the room and one from Dad for something else: Dad's term needs the room.

presentations.name: promise-any-category
presentations.description: thanks:2/<Dad>:*: two thank-yous from Dad in any categories.

presentations.name: promise-any-category-skips-app-categories
presentations.description: * matches general categories only: Dad's dzenq:like does not count.

presentations.name: promise-app-category-named
presentations.description: An app category counts when named: thanks:1/<Dad>:dzenq%3Alike.

presentations.name: promise-any-category-only-gratitudes
presentations.description: Only dzq:gratitude counts for * : an apology from Dad does not.

presentations.name: promise-before-since
presentations.description: The only thank-you is dated before the condition's 'since'.

presentations.name: promise-self-thanks-elsewhere
presentations.description: Marko's thank-yous to himself do not count toward Dad's promise.

presentations.name: promise-self-promise
presentations.description: Marko's promise to himself, earned with his own thank-yous.

presentations.name: promise-is-not-a-thank-you
presentations.description: A promise never counts as a thank-you: two promises, no gratitude.

presentations.name: promise-closed
presentations.description: Marko shows a promise the issuer has closed (a close digest in its KEL).

presentations.name: thanks-without-extension
presentations.description: The earned promise, checked by a verifier without the extension: thanks: is an unknown kind, never met.
